published_title: The Way Jawas Weren't Meant To Be
description:
CHANGED A FEW THING'S AND NOW IT MITE BE TURNIMENT READY!? LET ME KNOW WHAT YOU THINK

Thease little guys can take on any Jedi! Jawas are thought of as weak. Heh, most of the time they arn't thought of at all! TILL' NOW!!!
strategy:
Assuming that you did not draw this into hand or activate them.

Turn 1:Activate atleast 4 force

Using Location Location Location, pull up Jabba's Palace.

Using Jabba's Palace game text, pull up Audience Chamber.

Use Kuat Drive Yards to pull up Tatooine System

Turn 2: Activate atleast 10 force

Use L.L.L. to pull up Jawa Camp

End Turn or Draw Cards

Turn 3: Activate atleast 11 force

L.L.L. to pull up Jawa Canyon

The basic strategy is to begin with the Death Star, (this is to give me good amount of force and can use A Bright Center in The Universe to stop force drain modifiers especially from decks like those nasty Hoth decks, lightsabers etc.)  Also, starting with the Death Star confuses the opponent so he/she doesn't know what to expect from the deck.  Especial when right afterwards you deploy Tatooine locations.

You'll want to play this game very casually at first so that they don't know it's a Jawa deck right away.  If you don't need to, don't deploy all locations in the beginning.  This will make the opponent think he has the upper hand and he will deploy his stuff first.  Because the idea is to deploy as many Jawas as possible, targeting a single character or atleast few characters and wiping him out causing a lot of battle damage.

Now, dploy jabba to the chamber and pull  Wittin and put him in the chamber. with Sum and Vilainy you will be saveing a lota force and you can retrieve force. Maybe use Thok and Thug, or Boba Fett B.H. to guard him.  Wittin makes all Jawas anywhere else power +2. Drop a sandcrawler Then, maybe deploy the Double Lazer Cannon on it for power.  If not, it's very good destiny.

If played just right, using the right locations, etc. the jawas should be power 6-8 depending on the location.

Mosep is great to put in a sandcrawler or vehicle, or sometimes with a large band of jawas because he causes the opponent to lose force from his reserve deck.

Now, for space I threw in the bounty hunters.  Needless to explain, they're great for defending the home front above.

Well, that's about it.  Very simple, but effective if played right.  Remember, the idea is to play casually and not reveal too much at first.  Then, when the opportunity presents itself, deploy your Jawas and wreak havoc!

Thanks for reading and have fun! oh and do let me know what you think of this very silly but fun deck! UTTINY!!!
